title: Dangerous PHP construct (backtick) — review required
description: PHP evaluates or includes dynamically: `[^`]*$ (backtick). Backticks run shells, variable includes load attacker paths, extract and parse_str overwrite variables, and /e evaluates replacements. This lexical rule flags the construct; the reviewer removes it via subprocess with an args list.
remediation: Remove or use subprocess with an args list.
